answers.text: The excerpts state that fans can wear out with long-term use and separately advise contacting Danfoss for maintenance and service information, but do not state that contacting Danfoss resolves or addresses fan wear.
answers.rationale: The proposed relation links facts from separate statements without an explicit connection between fan wear and contacting Danfoss.

answers.text: The manual states that an illuminated Fault (Red) indicator means the Active Power Filter is malfunctioning; it does not state an unspecified cause of the indicator being on.
answers.rationale: The proposed failure mode merely restates the symptom instead of matching the stated malfunctioning condition.

answers.text: The excerpt identifies the buzzer as an alarm sounding to warn the user; it does not state that this symptom may indicate an unspecified failure mode.
answers.rationale: The parts description explains the buzzer’s warning function, not a troubleshooting symptom-to-failure relationship.
